POSEIDONANCIENT-FLOOD_GAIN.title: Flood Gain
POSEIDONANCIENT-FLOOD_GAIN.description: The first time each turn you deal at least [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] Attack damage in a single hit, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
POSEIDONANCIENT-HIGH_SURF.title: High Surf
POSEIDONANCIENT-HIGH_SURF.description: Whenever you play a Skill card, gain [blue]{DexterityThisTurn}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
POSEIDONANCIENT-HYDRAULIC_MIGHT.title: Hydraulic Might
POSEIDONANCIENT-HYDRAULIC_MIGHT.descript: Your Attacks deal [blue]100%[/blue] more damage on the first [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns of combat.
POSEIDONANCIENT-RAZOR_SHOALS.title: Razor Shoals
POSEIDONANCIENT-RAZOR_SHOALS.description: Your Attacks apply [blue]{RuptureToApply}[/blue] [gold]Rupture[/gold] on every hit.
POSEIDONANCIENT-SECOND_WAVE.title: Second Wave
POSEIDONANCIENT-SECOND_WAVE.description: Every [blue]2nd[blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards} additional card.
POSEIDONANCIENT-SLIPPERY_SLOPE.title: Slippery Slope
POSEIDONANCIENT-SLIPPERY_SLOPE.descripti: Your Attacks apply [blue]{FrothToApply}[/blue] [gold]Froth[/gold] on every hit.
POSEIDONANCIENT-WAVE_FLOURISH.title: Wave Flourish
POSEIDONANCIENT-WAVE_FLOURISH.descriptio: The first time each turn you draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards during your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
POSEIDONANCIENT-WAVE_STRIKE.title: Wave Strike
POSEIDONANCIENT-WAVE_STRIKE.description: The [blue]3rd[/blue] Attack played each turn is played an additional time.
